title: Roguelike run loop
excerpt: A minimal run loop connects encounter, reward choice, increased risk, run termination and restart.
lesson: Player control and combat precede encounters; rewards precede progression; death/reset completes the loop.

title: Roguelike content generation
excerpt: Procedural content needs deterministic seeds, valid connectivity and bounded encounter placement.
lesson: Room grammar and validation precede content variation and balancing.

title: RPG character progression
excerpt: Character stats, item data and progression rules share persistent identifiers and save boundaries.
lesson: Data models precede inventory, equipment, progression UI and persistence.

title: RPG quest and dialogue state
excerpt: Quest conditions and dialogue branches read and update shared world state.
lesson: State schema precedes quest runtime, dialogue conditions, journal UI and save/load tests.

title: Action combat feedback loop
excerpt: Input, movement, animation timing, hit detection, damage and audiovisual feedback form one testable loop.
lesson: Controller and animation events precede hit logic; metrics precede balancing.

title: Action enemy encounter
excerpt: Enemy perception, navigation and attack states depend on a stable player target and combat interface.
lesson: Player combat contract precedes enemy AI and encounter tuning.

title: Platformer movement foundation
excerpt: Movement parameters, collision rules and camera behavior define level metrics and checkpoint placement.
lesson: Movement prototype precedes level blockout, hazards and final camera tuning.

title: Platformer level validation
excerpt: Level validation checks reachability, recovery, checkpoint spacing and collectible readability using final movement metrics.
lesson: Blockout and movement tests precede art pass and content scaling.

title: Puzzle rule model
excerpt: Represent puzzle state and legal transitions independently from presentation so solutions, reset and undo can be tested.
lesson: Rule model precedes level authoring, hint generation and UI feedback.

title: Puzzle content pipeline
excerpt: Levels require solvability checks, difficulty ordering and playtest evidence before progression is finalized.
lesson: Editor or data format precedes level volume; telemetry and playtests precede difficulty tuning.

title: Simulation state and time
excerpt: A simulation needs explicit tick order, state ownership and deterministic update rules before economy and agents interact.
lesson: State model and time system precede economy, AI, persistence and speed controls.

title: Simulation information UI
excerpt: Players need summaries, alerts and drill-down views without coupling presentation to simulation updates.
lesson: Stable read models and event aggregation precede dashboards and notifications.

title: Visual novel dialogue runtime
excerpt: Dialogue data identifies speakers, lines, commands and choices while runtime state resolves branch conditions.
lesson: Dialogue schema precedes runtime, choice UI, localization and content import.

title: Visual novel save and history
excerpt: Save slots, backlog and skip behavior depend on stable script positions and persistent branch state.
lesson: Script identity and state serialization precede save UI, backlog and read-text skipping.
